vp_hall.name: Reefwright's Hall
vp_hall.description: A grown communal hall - the largest structure in a Vherathi settlement, its roofline rising sharpest over the entry.

vp_spire.name: Vein-Warden Spire
vp_spire.description: A tall tapering housing spire, leaning very slightly off vertical, climbed by a single line of bioluminescent veins.

vp_bloompod.name: Bloompod Dwelling
vp_bloompod.description: The smallest unit of Vherathi housing - a single rounded resin growth with one asymmetric window.

vp_bench.name: Grown Bench
vp_bench.description: A resin bench, thickened toward one end, standing on two uneven legs.

vp_planter.name: Planter Pod
vp_planter.description: A lopsided resin basin holding a single tall leaning frond.

vp_lantern_post.name: Lantern Stalk
vp_lantern_post.description: A thin curved resin stalk ending in a single bioluminescent bloom.
